description: This file defines a report for employee exits, including functions to generate report columns, fetch data with filters, generate chart data, and summarize report metrics. It is part of the ERPNext HR module.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the employee exits report, returning columns, data, chart, and summary.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report table.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches report data from the database based on filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Applies filters to the database query.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Generates chart data visualizing employee status distribution.

methods.name: get_report_summary
methods.description: Creates a summary of report metrics such as total resignations and pending items.
